title: City Offices Downtown: Talk, No Action
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened to discuss acquiring or leasing property in downtown Austin for city offices.
*   Councilmembers engaged in a discussion regarding potential downtown locations for city facilities.
*   Despite the focused discussion, no formal action or policy decision was made on the downtown property issue.
*   The meeting concluded swiftly, adjourning after the single agenda item was discussed.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
NOTICE OF SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
NOVEMBER 30,1998
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order, noting the presence of all Councilmembers.
Discuss acquisition/lease of property in the downtown area for city offices.
Discussion held, no action taken.
ADJOURNED at 3:15 p.m. on Councilmember Lewis' motion, Councilmember Garcia's second, 5-0
vote, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman and Councilmember Griffith out of the room.
These minutes were approved on February 17, 2000 on Mayor Pro Tern Goodman's motion,
Council Member Garcia's second on a 5-0 vote. Council Member Lewis and Spelman were off
the dais.
